verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a desktop game engine and editor, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics, or any opt-out control. The MIT-license and no-splash-screen items cover licensing and branding, not data collection, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
